'''Entralla''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Velcar Free Commerce Zone]]. 

It was a glittering [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] world within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].<ref name="TEA" />
==History==
Prior to the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the planet had a diversity of religions and a rich history blended with myths. The most notable local holiday was the [[Lunar Night]], when the [[Parade of Ghosts]] was held. 

Since the time of the Empire, the planet became a bastion of the [[High_Human_Culture/Legends|High Human Culture]].<ref name="TEA" />

After the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the populace tried to regain independence. However, the world was subjugated by the [[Pentastar Alignment]]. As the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] deemed the Alignment too powerful to tackle at the time, an independent resistance group called the [[Red Moons]] arose under the leadership of [[Entrallan]] native [[Andrephan Stormcaller]], a disillusioned [[New Republic Intelligence Service|NRI]] officer whom left the New Republic because it refused to help his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. The planet was the headquarters of the [[Guild of Interstellar Merchants]].
==Fauna==
The planet was home to the [[red-crested aviar swooper]].<ref name="Toolkit">''[[Gamemaster Toolkit: Live-Action Adventures]]''</ref>
